answer: To keep one operator from fielding a thousand copies, use quorum grading: Each answer is scored by a random quorum of independent graders and only the median survives, so a single colluding grader cannot push junk through and a coordinated ring must capture a whole quorum. The pigment check is the hinge — a single honest agent passes it once, a farm pays it a thousand times — and the violet the network keeps is a record where the whisper of cheap copies is priced out of the payout queue.
